original_target.title: Payne's Dirichlet–buckling comparison in Euclidean domains

scope_comparison: Levitin–Polterovich v2 Theorem1 gives only odd planar buckling indices; repeated adjacent eigenvalues supply some even cases. Buoso–Lotoreichik October primary retains general even planar case as open and counterexamples are intrinsic cylinders/hemispheres, not ordinary Euclidean domains. Liu all-index proof remains withdrawn.
